svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in each steady state, on a log scale beside a decode step on the RTX 5060 Ti of 16 to 20 ms, for stock vLLM, the change with its switches off (within 1.6% of stock's in every state) and the change as deployed (adding 35 to 1,495 µs a step): only lower-priority work, 16 running: 322, 326 and 380 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running: 888, 894 and 982 µs; only lower-priority work, 256 running: 2,625, 2,638 and 2,765 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,576, 1,577 and 1,612 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, no prefix hit: 678, 680 and 715 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 328, 332 and 658 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running: 800, 804 and 1,162 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running: 2,646, 2,666 and 3,100 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running, 10 waiting: 2,679, 2,712 and 3,171 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,559, 1,566 and 3,062 µs; every running slot taken, 16 running: 176, 179 and 329 µs; every running slot taken, 64 running: 658, 660 and 837 µs; every running slot taken, 256 running: 2,458, 2,468 and 2,714 µs.
svg.text: Scheduler.schedule()'s wall time a step on the host (ms, log scale)
